summary.value: Also known as Thought-Reader, Medium, Mesmerist.

system.description:
Built on Project FU's Esper.

FREE BENEFITS
  • increased maximum Mind Points — activated.

(House note: FU auto-applies this class benefit — the mechanical field is activated on the sheet. Rippers handles class identity through the Guise; the benefit itself is standard Project FU.)

SENSITIVE SKILLS

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000213]{Cognitive Focus} 【Max SL 5】

Start of your conflict turn: your focus is one ally able to hear you, or one enemy you can see suffering dazed, enraged and/or shaken. Until your next turn, +(SL) to Checks to examine the focus and to Accuracy/Magic Checks for attacks and offensive spells that include it.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000214]{Hypercognition} 【Max SL 5】

Spells and verses that include your focus among their targets cost (SL) less MP — (SL × 2) less if the focus is the only target — to a minimum of 0.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000215]{Navigator} 【Max SL 1】

Telepathy with any conscious ally within the same district; you count as hearing each other for Skills and effects. Ritualism for Aether purposes only — transport, information and tracking within the Aether.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000216]{Psychic Gifts} 【Max SL 5】

Each level grants one of the nine gifts: event-triggered reactions with an MP cost, scaling with the Brainwave Clock (4 sections, empty at the start of each scene).

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000217]{Psychokinesis} 【Max SL 1】

Accuracy Checks may replace one Attribute die with Willpower.
